Stanley heavy-duty staple gun ideal for a range of professional applications, including fixing drywall beads and scrim to plasterboard, securing carpets, fencing, and roof sheeting. Featuries Easy Squeeze technology to reduce user fatigue, whilst delivering added driving power into materials. Integrated anti-jam mechanism ensures continuous, reliable operation by preventing fastener jams, and a staple window offers clear visibility to indicate when a reload is needed. Stapler is quick and easy to reload, minimising downtime.
